adjudication.rationale: In admin-group controller, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (with a 0-count guard). If `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50), this returns one extra page (3 instead of 2). This can lead to an empty last page, especially since `next` can set `offset` to `user_count` (`Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`), and `findMembers` in `group.js` clamps `offset` to at most `user_count` rather than the last non-empty page offset.
